eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input, K = g.boars; window.__look = (pt) => { const e = g.engine.camera.position; const dx = pt.x - e.x, dy = pt.y - e.y, dz = pt.z - e.z; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); p.pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); p.update(1 / 30); g.engine.camera.updateMatrixWorld(); }; window.__scope = (on) => { if (on !== w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; window.__fire = () => { for (let i = 0; i < 90 && w.state !== 'ready'; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } inp.buttonsPressed |= 1; w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !g.hunting.lastShot; i++) g.hunting.update(1 / 60); const s = g.hunting.lastShot || { kind: 'nada', zone: null, distance: Infinity, lethal: false, points: 0 }; return { tipo: s.kind, zona: s.zone, dist: Number.isFinite(s.distance) ? +s.distance.toFixed(1) : null, letal: s.lethal, pontos: s.points }; }; window.__census = () => { const st = {}; for (const b of K.active) st[b.state] = (st[b.state] || 0) + 1; return { total: K.active.length, vivos: K.living, estados: st }; }; return __census(); })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, K = g.boars, e = g.engine.camera.position; K.frozen = true; const f = { x: -Math.sin(p.yaw), z: -Math.cos(p.yaw) }, r = { x: Math.cos(p.yaw), z: -Math.sin(p.yaw) }; const at = (dx, dist) => { const v = e.clone(); v.x += f.x * dist + r.x * dx; v.z += f.z * dist + r.z * dx; v.y = 0; return v; }; window.__show = [K.spawn(at(-2.4, 6), p.yaw + Math.PI / 2, 1.1, 0), K.spawn(at(0.2, 7.5), p.yaw + Math.PI / 2 + 0.6, 0.95, 1), K.spawn(at(2.8, 6), p.yaw - Math.PI / 2, 1, 0)]; __show[0].pose('forage', 0); __show[1].pose('gallop', 1.1); __show[2].pose('dead', 0); p.pitch = -0.14; return __show.map(b => b.state); })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, K = g.boars, P = g.player; const log = []; K.onSpawn = (b, init) => { const dx = b.pos.x - P.position.x, dz = b.pos.z - P.position.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz); const fx = -Math.sin(P.yaw), fz = -Math.cos(P.yaw); log.push({ d: Math.round(d), ang: Math.round(Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (dx * fx + dz * fz) / d))) * 57.3), mata: +g.biome.forest(b.pos.x, b.pos.z).toFixed(2) }); }; let maxPen = 0, nan = 0, below = 0; const moved = new Map(); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 3600; i++) { K.update(1 / 30); if (i % 30 === 0) for (const b of K.active) { if (!Number.isFinite(b.pos.x + b.pos.y + b.pos.z)) nan++; if (b.group.position.y < g.terrain.heightAt(b.pos.x, b.pos.z)) below++; for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) { const cl = c.colliders; for (let j = 0; j < cl.length; j += 3) { const pen = cl[j + 2] + 0.3 * b.scale - Math.hypot(b.pos.x - cl[j], b.pos.z - cl[j + 1]); if (pen > maxPen) maxPen = pen; } } } } const ms = (performance.now() - t0) / 3600; const near = log.filter(s => s.d < 140); return { msPorQuadro: +ms.toFixed(3), ...__census(), nan, abaixoDoChao: below, maiorPenetracaoEmTroncoM: +maxPen.toFixed(2), spawns: log.length, menorAnguloSpawnPerto: near.length ? Math.min(...near.map(s => s.ang)) : null, densidadeMataNoSpawn: log.length ? Math.min(...log.map(s => s.mata)) : null }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, K = g.boars, p = g.player; const res = {}; const b = K.active.find(x => x.alive) || K.spawn(p.position.clone().setX(p.position.x + 30), 0, 1, 0); const place = (dist, crouched, vx) => { b.forage(); const a = 1.1; p.position.set(b.pos.x + Math.cos(a) * dist, 0, b.pos.z + Math.sin(a) * dist); p.position.y = g.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z); p.crouched = crouched; p.running = false; p.velocity.set(vx, 0, 0); K.update(1 / 30); return b.state; }; res.agachadoParado12m = place(12, true, 0); res.andando20m = place(20, false, 3); res.andando8m = place(8, false, 3); p.crouched = false; p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); return res; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, K = g.boars, p = g.player; for (let i = K.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) K.release(i); K.spawnTimer = 1e9; p.position.set(-29, g.terrain.heightAt(-29, -28), -28); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.crouched = true; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); const e = g.engine.camera; p.update(1 / 30); e.updateMatrixWorld(); let spot = null; for (let a = 0; a < 6.28 && !spot; a += 0.15) { const x = p.position.x + Math.cos(a) * 32, z = p.position.z + Math.sin(a) * 32; const target = new p.position.constructor(x, g.terrain.heightAt(x, z) + 0.6, z); const dir = target.clone().sub(e.position); const dist = dir.length(); dir.normalize(); if (g.terrain.raycast(e.position, dir, dist) < dist) continue; if (g.chunks.raycastObstacles(e.position, dir, dist).kind) continue; if (!g.chunks.isClear(x, z, 1.5)) continue; spot = { x, z, a }; } if (!spot) return 'sem linha de visão'; window.__spot = spot; K.frozen = true; const b = K.spawn(new p.position.constructor(spot.x, 0, spot.z), -spot.a, 1.05, 0); window.__boar = b; return { dist: 32, estado: b.state }; })()
